messages:
ana: quick sync on prompt-sets + evals UI. Need decisions: compact vs annotated default, undo behavior for bulk approve, scorecard copy, SR keyboard flow. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (frames 40-44) :eyes:
kevin: I'd default to annotated for new users, allow compact toggle persisted in prefs. Avoid blocking modals for small batches.
maria: define small? propose: <=75 items = instant approve + 8s undo toast; 76-500 = staged approvals (sidebar) with quick revert; >500 = async job w/ id.
tom: A11y: toast must be announced (role=alert + aria-live=assertive). After undo, focus should return to the table header or last focused row.
kevin: add ctrl+z to undo while toast visible (with clear note in shortcuts). watch conflicts.
eva-bot: visual check: compact diff labels fail AA at 12px. Suggest 13px semibold or darker token.
maria: bump to 13px 600 weight and change color if fails.
ana: annotated mode should auto-collapse unchanged groups by default to reduce noise. Expand-all affordance.
tom: ensure collapse uses aria-expanded + aria-controls and supports arrow keys + enter. Use roving tabindex for groups.
kevin: Scorecard legend copy: swap "No judgement yet" -> "Not scored" and add tooltip "Scores 0 (fail) to 5 (excellent)." Link to scoring guide.
maria: Approve CTA copy: `Approve 18 examples — marks them passed for this suite. Undo via banner.` For large job CTA: `Start approval job` and show ETA.
kevin: small microcopy: "Select all in view" -> "Select all visible examples (approx.)" with exact count in tooltip on hover.
maria: QA: add SR walkthrough to checklist: navigate rows, expand group, inline comment, stage/approve, use undo.
tom: eva-bot flagged rs-compact-042: inline comment button steals focus and blocks row nav. likely tabindex. I'll review once PR is up.
kevin: I'll open PR for keyboard/a11y fixes + tests for toast announce, ctrl+z, focus restore, and large-job flow. @tom please review.
ana: poll: annotated default + compact toggle? :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:

nana: closing after PR links are added.
